# Pittsburg County Genealogical and Historical Society

> A nonprofit organization dedicated to helping researchers discover and document Pittsburg County, Oklahoma ancestors through genealogical research, historical records, and community resources since 1979.

The society maintains extensive collections of cemetery records, funeral home documents, census data, and historical publications focused on Pittsburg County and the surrounding Southeastern Oklahoma region, including resources related to the Choctaw Nation and Indian Territory heritage.

## Key Topics

- Pittsburg County genealogy
- Oklahoma ancestors
- Cemetery records
- U.S. Census records
- Historical records
- Indian Territory
- Choctaw Nation
- McAlester history
- Family history research
- Genealogical collections
- Funeral records
- Local history
- Volunteer research
- Tobucksy County
- Southeastern Oklahoma

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://pittsburgcogenealogical.org): Homepage for Pittsburg County genealogical research and historical society.
- [About Us](https://pittsburgcogenealogical.org/about-us): Mission and history of Pittsburg County Genealogical and Historical Society.
- [Contact Us](https://pittsburgcogenealogical.org/contact-us): Contact information and query submission for genealogical research.

## Research Resources

- [Our Library](https://pittsburgcogenealogical.org/our-resources): Library resources including cemetery, funeral, and genealogical records.
- [Our Publications](https://pittsburgcogenealogical.org/our-publications): Catalog of genealogical publications and historical records for sale.

## Community & Updates

- [Tobucksy County Newsletter](https://pittsburgcogenealogical.org/tobucksy-county-newsletter): Quarterly newsletter with genealogy articles and society events.
